claim: When benchmark selection favors certain strategies, LLM agents used for post-training optimize for single tasks rather than producing generalist models.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by designing a benchmark suite with varying strategy biases and measuring whether agents trained on it exhibit specialization or generalization across tasks.

conditions: benchmark selection inadvertently favors certain strategies
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported experimental setup and benchmark suite; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Benchmark selection that favors–agent specialization instead boundary
